billingEmail.description: The email address to which invoices are sent.

teamId.description: The team's ID associated with the account.

salesChannel.description:
The sales channel from which the account was created:
- `SELF_SERVE` — The user purchased the account plan.
- `SALES_SERVE` — The account was purchased through the Postman sales team process.

available.description: The number of the team's available slots.

consumed.description: The number of currently-billed team members.

total.description: The total number of slots available to the team.

unbilled.description: The number of unbilled slots if [auto-flex billing](https://learning.postman.com/auto-flex-policy/) is available.
